# Ashlr MD

> Open-source Markdown app for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Agents install one command, call a CLI that prints JSON, and drive the live document over MCP.

Ashlr MD is a desktop app plus `mdopen` and the `mdopener-mcp` server. People read and edit `.md` files. Agents open, edit, export, and request a human review.

The install command, from a checkout on macOS or Linux:

```bash
SKIP_APP_BUILD=1 bash scripts/install.sh
```

Then:

```bash
mdopener-mcp doctor --json
mdopener-mcp setup --local --json
mdopener-mcp --ashlr-handshake --json
claude mcp add --scope user ashlr-md "$(command -v mdopener-mcp)"
codex mcp add ashlr-md -- "$(command -v mdopener-mcp)"
python3 scripts/connect-cursor.py
```

## CLI

- [doctor --fix](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/doctor-fix.md): `mdopener-mcp doctor --fix --json` previews repairs and writes nothing
- [Handshake](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/ashlr-handshake.md): `mdopener-mcp --ashlr-handshake --json`
- [Local AI](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/local-ai.md): `localInference`, offline mode, and base URL rules
- [Phantom](https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-md/blob/main/docs/PHANTOM.md): how Phantom calls `mdopen`
